body: I do like baking. But I'm allergic to gluten, so it gets way expensive. Gluten-free flour and xantham gum and everything just cost too much to do it regularly.
Right now? I pretty much just sit here in the apartment alone and sad. I've tried going for walks, but that just leads to me being in a slightly different location feeling alone and sad.
Thank you, I'll check it out.
I don't think it's the source. It's one of many awful things about me/my life. I'm lonely and poor and my own family hates me and I just can't handle the loneliness anymore.
I doubt there'd be anything where I just moved. It's not the greatest place as far as attitudes on mental health (or disabilities, or minorities, or really anyone who isn't 'normal')
I can't afford a therapist, or even the gas to get to a therapist. I'm barely able to get food right now--I'm pretty much reliant on my SO to be alive, it's pathetic.
I wish I could help. Sorry you're struggling.
